purpose: How a home-security dealer chooses and operates its monitoring stack, builds recurring monthly revenue from monitoring, cloud video and service plans priced as mechanisms rather than folklore figures, diagnoses and prevents account attrition through an ethical retention playbook, keeps contract terms and renewals honest under consumer-protection scrutiny, and manages the monitored-account book so its lifetime economics and eventual diligence value compound instead of leaking.
assumptions: no observed dataset supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
the operator is a small independent home-security dealer that holds and services its own monitored accounts, buying central-station monitoring and interactive/video platform services at wholesale

all monitoring rates, wholesale charges, service costs and account-book multiples are treated as mechanisms or qualitative bands; every real figure is read from the operator's own station agreement, platform statements and market bids, never asserted by this KB

alarm-business licensing, permit regimes, false-alarm ordinances and consumer-contract rules vary by state and city; every regulatory statement here names an obligation class and carries a verify-current-rules-in-your-jurisdiction flag

monitored systems are defensive intrusion, fire and life-safety systems installed with the customer's knowledge and consent; account creation and installation have already happened upstream of this KB
exclusions: dealer-program selection and account-creation economics - equipment subsidy vs margin funding, monitoring wholesale-vs-retail spread at account creation, the account sale-vs-hold decision at creation, holdback and chargeback mechanics, territory and segment targeting, and lead generation or ethical in-home selling - all belong to the dealer-programs-and-account-economics KB

site survey and risk walk-through, panel/sensor/doorbell/camera package design, installation workmanship and commissioning tests, install-time permits and false-alarm-ordinance filings, low-voltage licensing at install, and subcontract-vs-in-house installation trade-offs - all belong to the system-design-and-installation KB
any offensive, covert or unlawful surveillance use; monitoring in this KB exists solely to prevent, detect and alarm intrusions and life-safety events for a consenting customer
asserting specific licensing, permit, false-alarm-fine or consumer-contract rules for any named jurisdiction; the KB names obligation classes and always defers to local verification
quoting specific monitoring prices, wholesale rates, swap-hardware costs or account-book multiples as fact; all economics are described as mechanisms or qualitative bands
personalized legal, financial, tax or insurance advice; the content is educational and operational knowledge for running the monitoring side of the business

competency_questions.question: Should I offer central-station professional monitoring, self/cloud-notification-only monitoring, or a tiered mix, and what do I owe a wholesale station partner before I trust it with my accounts?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: MONITORING_STACK_CHOICE distinguishes dispatched professional monitoring from notification-only tiers, lists the station-vetting criteria (listing/certification class, redundancy, response performance, signal formats, account portability), and ties the choice to the wholesale-charge mechanism and to honest tier disclosure

competency_questions.question: What does one monitored account actually earn per month after monitoring and platform costs, and how do I measure attrition so I know whether my book is compounding or leaking?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: RMR_ENGINE_FRAME defines account margin as retail RMR minus stacked wholesale, platform and service-reserve costs, defines gross vs net and unit- vs RMR-weighted attrition with account life as its reciprocal mechanism, and ACCOUNT_HEALTH_SCORE turns those inputs into a per-account decision score

competency_questions.question: How do I grow RMR beyond base monitoring - interactive services, cloud video, service plans - without selling anything the home does not need?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SERVICE_TIER_ARCHITECTURE lays out the tier ladder with honest inclusions and exclusions per tier, CLOUD_VIDEO_RMR covers video-storage attach and its privacy limits, and SERVICE_PLAN_ECONOMICS prices plans from the operator's own measured service costs

competency_questions.question: What actually causes monitored accounts to cancel, and which of those causes can I control?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ATTRITION_DRIVER_MAP enumerates the driver taxonomy (moves, price/value doubt, competitive takeover, service failure, non-pay, life events, forced-technology fatigue), separates controllable from uncontrollable, and requires every cancellation to be coded to a driver with evidence

competency_questions.question: What early-warning signals tell me an account is drifting toward cancellation, and who acts on each signal?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CHURN_SIGNAL_RADAR names the leading indicators (payment failures, app disengagement, repeat tickets, failed test signals, home-listing signals, competitor sweep seasons) and routes each to an owner and playbook

competency_questions.question: How do I run a save conversation that keeps the account without pressure, trickery or cancellation obstacles?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SAVE_PLAYBOOK requires diagnosing the real reason first, fixing service causes before touching price, allowing downgrades as saves, capping attempts, and keeping lawful cancellation easy; DISCLOSURE_AND_CONSENT constrains every save offer to restate terms honestly

competency_questions.question: A good customer is selling their home - how do I keep the relationship and the account alive through the move?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: MOVER_PROGRAM describes the two-account play - transfer the customer to the new home under a fresh agreement and win the incoming occupant on the equipment left behind with fresh consent, never silent billing continuation

competency_questions.question: What must my monitoring agreement and my pre-signature conversation disclose about term, auto-renewal, cancellation and cost to stay honest and inside consumer-protection law?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CONTRACT_TERMS_DESIGN covers term, renewal structure, cancellation windows, rate-change and assignability clauses with the evergreen-clause consumer-protection flag, and DISCLOSURE_AND_CONSENT specifies the plain-language pre-signature ritual, vulnerable-customer care and the stored consent artifacts

competency_questions.question: When and how can I change monitoring rates without breaking trust or triggering a churn wave?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: RATE_INTEGRITY separates cost-pass-through from margin actions, requires contractual authority and advance notice, exempts at-risk segments, and measures the churn response of every action; RENEWAL_PRACTICE places rate talk inside an honest value conversation

competency_questions.question: How do I keep every account's signal path alive through carrier radio sunsets and platform end-of-life without fear-selling the upgrades?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SIGNAL_PATH_RESILIENCE covers communicator inventory, supervision and dead-path detection, and SUNSET_UPGRADE_CAMPAIGNS turns announced sunsets into planned campaigns whose urgency framing uses only the dated carrier or manufacturer notice

competency_questions.question: An account keeps generating false dispatches and the city is fining the customer - how do I manage false alarms as an ongoing service so the account survives?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: FALSE_ALARM_STEWARDSHIP describes dispatch review, root-cause triage (user, device, design), retraining, verification-protocol tuning, and the local-ordinance obligation class with its verify-locally flag

competency_questions.question: What determines what my account book is worth to a buyer or lender, and what records must exist for the book to survive diligence?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BOOK_VALUE_DRIVERS names the priced drivers (attrition history, RMR and margin mix, contract structure and assignability, density, signal-path currency, documentation) with multiples framed strictly as a market mechanism, and BOOK_AUDIT_READINESS defines the per-account diligence file and audit habit

competency_questions.question: How do I handle a non-paying account without silently cutting off a home that relies on fire or medical monitoring?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: COLLECTIONS_AND_NONPAY lays out the dunning ladder, distinguishes can't-pay, won't-pay and billing-error, and states the life-safety rule that suspension of such accounts requires documented human contact, dated notice and jurisdiction-rule verification

competency_questions.question: What must happen in the first ninety days after installation hand-off so the account does not become early-life churn?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ONBOARDING_HANDOFF specifies contact-tree verification at the station, a live test signal with the customer, app enrollment with one daily-value automation, false-alarm basics and a scheduled courtesy check-in

glossary.definition: The monthly subscription revenue attached to a monitored account - monitoring, interactive services, cloud video and service plans combined; the unit in which a dealer's book, attrition and valuation are all denominated.

A staffed monitoring facility (typically third-party and wholesale to small dealers) that receives alarm signals, executes verification protocols and requests emergency dispatch; certification/listing classes and redundant facilities distinguish stations a dealer can responsibly resell.

A notification-only service tier in which alarm and camera events go to the customer's own phone via a cloud platform with no operator dispatch; honest tier design states this absence of dispatch explicitly.

The rate at which monitored accounts are lost; gross attrition counts all losses, net attrition offsets reconnects, movers retained and takeovers; both exist unit-weighted and RMR-weighted, and expected account life behaves as the reciprocal of the attrition rate.
The panel component that transmits alarm signals over a path - legacy phone line, IP, LTE/5G cellular or dual-path; its carrier radio generation determines exposure to sunset events.

A carrier's dated shutdown of an older cellular generation, after which every communicator on that radio goes silent; an announced sunset converts part of the book into a forced-upgrade population on a deadline.

A dispatch regime (imposed by some municipalities or offered as a service class) in which police respond only after an alarm is verified by call, video or audio; it changes station protocols and what the dealer may promise about response.

An auto-renewal contract provision that rolls the agreement into successive terms unless the customer cancels in a notice window; a consumer-protection-sensitive clause class on which many jurisdictions impose disclosure and reminder duties - verify locally.

A retention interaction with a cancelling or at-risk customer; run ethically it diagnoses the cause, fixes service before price, may downgrade the tier to fit real need, and never obstructs lawful cancellation.

The market mechanism by which a buyer or lender prices a monitored-account book as a multiple of its RMR; the multiple offered moves with demonstrated attrition, margin, contract quality and documentation, and any real number is discovered from actual bids, never assumed.

nodes.definition: Fix the economic frame the whole subdomain runs on: the monitored account, not the installation, is the product. Each account is a small annuity whose monthly margin is retail RMR minus the stacked costs beneath it - the wholesale central-station charge, cellular and interactive-platform fees, card-processing drag and an expected service-cost reserve - and whose worth compounds with expected account life. Define the measurement discipline here: gross attrition versus net attrition (net of reconnects, retained movers and takeover wins), unit-weighted versus RMR-weighted rates, cohort views that separate early-life from mature losses, and expected account life as the reciprocal-of-attrition mechanism. Every downstream decision - tier design, save spending, rate actions, book valuation - is judged against lifetime account economics computed from the operator's own station agreement and platform statements, never against a single month's install margin or an industry folklore figure.

included: account-level margin mechanism (retail RMR minus stacked costs)
lifetime framing for all downstream trade-offs
excluded: how the account was created or funded (dealer-program KB)
specific dollar rates or costs - read from the operator's own contracts

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: the operator's measured account margins or cohort attrition depart materially from the frame's heuristic priors

pros.claim: Lifetime framing makes retention spending legible as investment rather than cost
pros.example: a no-charge service visit that preserves a healthy multi-year account is obviously right once judged against remaining account life instead of that month's truck-roll cost

pros.claim: Separating gross from net attrition stops reconnects and mover retentions from masking real losses
pros.example: a book that looks flat on net numbers can be quietly replacing long-tenured accounts with fragile early-life ones that gross and cohort views expose

cons.claim: Lifetime framing can be abused to excuse chronic underpricing and overservice
cons.example: keeping a deeply negative-margin account alive for years on the mantra that RMR is sacred, when its trailing service costs will never be recovered

failure_modes: judging saves and service spending against the current month instead of remaining account life
reporting only net attrition so the board never sees the gross leak
leaving platform and processing fees out of margin math so every tier looks more profitable than it is
acceptance_tests: the operator can state, for any account, its RMR, each stacked cost class beneath it, and the gross, net, unit- and RMR-weighted attrition of its cohort, all sourced from the operator's own statements
revisit_triggers: the operator's own account-level P&L or cohort attrition history contradicts the frame's prior weighting
a new recurring cost class (platform fee change, processing change) appears in the stack

nodes.definition: Bind the whole monitoring operation to its lawful, defensive purpose: systems are monitored to prevent, detect and alarm intrusion, fire and life-safety events for a consenting customer, and nothing in the RMR machine may bend that. The boundary has three faces. Purpose: no covert or offensive surveillance use, and requests to repurpose cameras or monitoring against a household member, neighbor or third party are refused. Privacy: cloud-video footage belongs to the customer; dealer and station access is minimal, logged, and limited to service and alarm verification; retention windows are a design decision, not an accident. Legality: alarm-company licensing and registration for monitoring and alarm sales is a jurisdiction-specific obligation class that varies by state and city and must be verified locally before operating, expanding or acquiring accounts in a new territory - this KB never asserts a specific rule. Marketing and retention language never manufactures fear or invents threat claims.

included: cloud-video privacy, access-logging and retention discipline
licensing/registration obligation class with verify-locally flag
no-fear-selling rule for all monitoring and retention language
excluded: install-time permits and ordinance filings (installation KB)
asserting any jurisdiction's specific licensing or privacy statute

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a licensing, privacy or consumer-protection rule change in any served jurisdiction, or an incident showing the boundary was crossed

pros.claim: A bright-line boundary protects the dealer from the liabilities that destroy small alarm companies
pros.example: declining a customer's request to point a monitored camera into a neighbor's yard avoids a privacy claim no monitoring margin would ever repay

cons.claim: Strict purpose and privacy discipline occasionally costs revenue a looser competitor will take
cons.example: refusing a covert-surveillance request loses that sale even though a less careful rival will install it

failure_modes: expanding monitoring sales into a new state without checking its alarm-licensing obligation class
letting technicians browse customer video without a logged service reason
urgency copy in a renewal or sunset letter drifting into invented crime claims
acceptance_tests: every territory served has a verified-locally licensing check on file, video access is logged with a service reason, and no marketing or retention artifact contains an unverifiable threat claim
revisit_triggers: entry into a new jurisdiction or a licensing-rule change in a served one
a video-access or purpose-misuse incident anywhere in the operation

nodes.definition: Decide what monitoring products the dealer offers and on whose infrastructure they run. Professionally monitored tiers ride a third-party wholesale central station, which must be vetted like a co-founder: certification/listing class of the facility, redundant geographically-separated centers, average response and verification performance the station will evidence, supported signal formats and verification capabilities (two-way voice, video and audio verification), dealer-facing tooling, and - decisive for the book's future - contractual portability of accounts if the dealer ever needs to move stations. Self/cloud-notification-only tiers (app alerts, no operator dispatch) are legitimate lower rungs only when the absence of dispatch is stated plainly at sale. The stack choice weighs the wholesale-charge mechanism per account, what dispatch promises the dealer may lawfully and honestly make, insurance-certificate needs of customers, and how the mix positions the dealer against DIY platforms without imitating their silence about what self-monitoring does not do.

included: station vetting criteria and wholesale-charge mechanism
dispatched vs notification-only tier definitions and their honest boundaries
excluded: panel and sensor hardware selection (installation KB)
which dealer program subsidizes equipment (dealer-program KB)
asserting specific wholesale rates

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: evidence on the station's real response performance, a portability dispute, or a material wholesale-term change

pros.claim: A vetted, redundant station lets a small dealer honestly sell big-company-grade response
pros.example: a two-center station with evidenced response performance satisfies both an anxious customer and their insurer's certificate request without the dealer building anything

pros.claim: An honest notification-only tier captures price-sensitive customers without corroding trust
pros.example: a customer who declines dispatched monitoring but accepts app-only alerts stays in the book and can upgrade later, because the tier never pretended to dispatch

cons.claim: Station lock-in without account portability can trap the entire book
cons.example: a station agreement that blocks bulk signal-transfer leaves the dealer hostage when service quality slides or wholesale terms worsen

failure_modes: signing a station on wholesale price alone and discovering its verification protocols embarrass the dealer at 3 a.m.
selling a self-monitored tier without stating the absence of dispatch, which surfaces later as a betrayal
promising response times the station never contracted to
acceptance_tests: the chosen station's certification class, redundancy, verification capabilities and account-portability clause are documented, and every tier sheet states whether operator dispatch is included
revisit_triggers: station response performance degrades or its wholesale terms change
a verified-response ordinance or verification-technology shift changes what tiers must contain

nodes.definition: Keep every account's alarm signals actually deliverable, because a monitored account that cannot reach the station is a silent liability wearing an RMR label. Maintain a communicator inventory per account - legacy phone line, IP, LTE/5G cellular, dual-path - with each unit's carrier radio generation recorded. Set supervision intervals so a dead path is detected in hours or days, not discovered at the burglary; watch the failed-to-test report as a daily operational artifact and treat every silent account as an open incident with an owner. Manage path technology as a lifecycle: carrier radio generations age toward sunset, panel platforms reach end-of-life, and the inventory is what converts those industry events from ambush into plannable campaigns. Path hardware swap decisions are costed against remaining account life, not against this month's service budget.

included: path lifecycle awareness feeding sunset campaigns
excluded: initial communicator installation and wiring quality (installation KB)
the outreach campaign itself (sunset-campaign node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: supervision data showing path-failure rates by communicator class, or a new sunset announcement

pros.claim: Supervision converts invisible path death into a routine service ticket
pros.example: a short supervision interval catches a cellular communicator killed by a power surge the same week, instead of at a break-in months later

cons.claim: Tight supervision and dual-path hardware add recurring cost the customer never consciously values
cons.example: dual-path service fees on every account thin margin for a resilience benefit that only proves itself in rare failures

failure_modes: no radio-generation inventory, so a carrier sunset announcement triggers panic instead of a plan
failed-to-test reports piling up unowned until a silent account has an event
treating a dead path as a billing opportunity rather than an urgent service duty
acceptance_tests: every account has a recorded communicator type and radio generation, a supervision interval appropriate to its tier, and the failed-to-test queue is worked to zero on a stated cadence
revisit_triggers: a carrier announces a radio sunset or a platform announces end-of-life
the failed-to-test queue's age distribution worsens

nodes.definition: Run forced technology transitions - carrier radio sunsets of the kind the industry lived through when older cellular generations were shut down, panel-platform end-of-life, camera-line discontinuations - as planned retention campaigns instead of churn events. The campaign mechanism: pull the affected population from the communicator inventory, sequence outreach in waves starting far ahead of the carrier's announced date, decide subsidize-versus-charge for swap hardware as an account-lifetime decision per segment (a long-tenured healthy account may earn a free swap that a marginal account does not), route swap visits through normal service scheduling, and verify each completed swap with a live signal test. Urgency framing uses only the verifiable, dated carrier or manufacturer notice - the deadline is real and needs no embellishment - and never manufactured fear. Accounts unreachable or declining by the deadline get documented final notices, because a knowingly-dead path cannot be left billing as if monitored.

included: affected-population inventory pull and wave sequencing
honest deadline framing and final-notice handling
excluded: inventing swap prices (operator's own hardware costs decide)
install workmanship of the swap itself (installation KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: measured completion and churn rates from the operator's own sunset waves

pros.claim: A sunset run as a campaign becomes a touchpoint that deepens accounts instead of losing them
pros.example: a swap visit that also refreshes batteries and re-trains the app turns a forced upgrade into visible service, and some customers add video while the tech is there from genuine want

cons.claim: Campaigns are expensive and stragglers are stubborn
cons.example: the last stretch of an affected population resists every contact channel, and each holdout represents a truck roll, a subsidy decision and possible churn anyway

failure_modes: starting outreach so late the deadline forces rushed, resented visits
blanket-subsidizing swaps without segmenting by account health, torching margin
leaving post-deadline accounts billing on a knowingly-dead path
acceptance_tests: the affected population is enumerated with wave dates, every completed swap has a live signal test on record, every urgency artifact cites the dated carrier or manufacturer notice, and no post-deadline account bills without a documented path status
revisit_triggers: the carrier moves the sunset date or a new end-of-life is announced
campaign completion rates fall behind the wave plan

nodes.definition: Design the RMR ladder the dealer sells: base professional monitoring; interactive/app control (remote arming, notifications, automations); cloud video storage; and the service/maintenance plan - each tier a distinct promise with a distinct cost stack. The architecture rules: every tier sheet states plainly what the tier includes and what it does not (the notification-only tier says 'no operator dispatch'; the video tier says what retention window the customer gets), per-tier margin is computed as retail minus the stacked wholesale, platform and reserve costs specific to that tier, and attach is need-driven - the ladder exists so a customer can be placed on the rung that fits the home, not pushed up it. Tier boundaries are also service boundaries: what each tier entitles the customer to when something breaks must be written before the first sale, because retro-defining it later is where trust and margin both leak.

included: tier ladder definition with honest inclusions and exclusions
excluded: the in-home selling of tiers (dealer-program KB)
asserting specific tier prices
camera hardware choice (installation KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: attach, downgrade and complaint data by tier from the operator's own book

pros.claim: A written ladder with honest boundaries makes every later conversation cheaper
pros.example: when a customer asks why a repair is billable, the tier sheet they signed already answered it, converting a fight into a lookup

pros.claim: Distinct per-tier cost stacks expose which RMR is actually profitable
pros.example: computing video-tier margin after platform storage fees can reveal the flagship tier earns less than plain monitoring, redirecting push

cons.claim: Too many rungs confuse customers and staff alike
cons.example: a five-tier ladder with overlapping video options produces mis-sold accounts that churn at first bill surprise

failure_modes: tiers defined by marketing adjectives instead of enumerated entitlements
attach targets quietly overriding the need-driven rule
per-tier margin never recomputed after a platform fee change
acceptance_tests: each tier has a one-page sheet with inclusions, exclusions and service entitlements, and a per-tier margin computation from current wholesale and platform statements
revisit_triggers: a platform or wholesale fee change shifts any tier's margin
mis-sold-tier complaints or downgrade patterns cluster on one rung

nodes.definition: Operate cloud video storage as a distinct RMR line with its own economics and its own ethics. Economics: storage-plan design (retention window length, per-camera versus per-site pricing structure) with platform storage fees treated as a pass-through cost mechanism the plan must clear; the natural attach moment is installation hand-off while the app is being enrolled, coordinated with onboarding rather than cold-called later. Value proof is the clip that was there when the customer needed it - a retrieval that worked after a porch theft retains better than any discount. Ethics: the boundary node governs - footage is the customer's, retention windows are disclosed, dealer access is logged and service-only, and the tier's limits are stated honestly: cloud video documents and deters, and unless the account carries an actual video-verification service into the station, it does not by itself change dispatch. Camera-health visibility (offline cameras, full storage) is part of the service, because a video subscription on a dead camera is billing for nothing.

included: storage-plan structure and pass-through cost mechanism
excluded: camera selection and placement (installation KB)
covert or third-party surveillance uses (boundary)
asserting per-camera storage prices

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: video attach, engagement and churn data from the operator's own app analytics and cancellations

pros.claim: Video subscriptions deepen both RMR and the evidence of value
pros.example: a doorbell clip that identified a package thief becomes the story the customer tells neighbors, retaining the account and seeding referrals

cons.claim: Video is the churn-prone rung of the ladder
cons.example: a customer who never opens the app quietly concludes the storage fee buys nothing and cancels the add-on at the first rate letter, sometimes taking the whole account's goodwill with it

failure_modes: billing storage on cameras known to be offline
implying video speeds police response when no video-verification service exists on the account
retention windows or dealer access never disclosed in plain terms
acceptance_tests: every video subscription states its retention window and access policy, camera-offline alerts route to service, and no sales artifact promises dispatch effects video does not have on that account
revisit_triggers: platform storage pricing or API terms change
video-tier churn or dormant-app rates rise above the book's norm

nodes.definition: Design the service/maintenance plan on measured cost mechanisms rather than wishful flat fees. Inputs the operator measures on its own book: fully-loaded truck-roll cost (tech time, vehicle, opportunity), the remote-first resolution rate (what share of tickets die on a phone call or app-side fix), battery and sensor consumable cycles by device class, and the fat tail of chronic systems that consume multiples of an average account's service budget. The plan's scope states honestly what it covers and what it excludes (customer damage, cosmetic issues, additions), its price is set so the measured incident rate clears cost with margin, and remote diagnostics are the first move on every ticket because the cheapest truck roll is the one that never leaves. The plan is also a retention instrument - an account whose problems get fixed fast and free-at-point-of-service cancels less - but that retention value is a bonus on sound plan economics, never a subsidy excuse for unsound ones.

included: measured cost inputs (truck roll, remote-fix rate, consumable cycles)
plan price as a mechanism over measured incident rates
excluded: warranty terms on the original installation (installation KB)
asserting plan price points

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: the operator's measured ticket mix, truck-roll cost and chronic-system distribution

pros.claim: Plans priced off measured incidents survive their own success
pros.example: knowing the true remote-fix rate lets the plan absorb a bad month of truck rolls without panic repricing

cons.claim: Generous plans invite the chronic-system tail to eat the pool
cons.example: a handful of endlessly-faulting systems can consume the margin of dozens of quiet accounts if no chronic flag exists

failure_modes: copying a competitor's plan price with no measurement of own costs
plan scope so vague every dispute resolves against the dealer
no remote-first discipline, rolling trucks for battery reseats
acceptance_tests: plan price is derived from documented truck-roll cost, remote-fix rate and incident frequency measured on the operator's own book, and the plan document enumerates exclusions
revisit_triggers: measured incident rates or truck-roll costs drift from the pricing assumptions
chronic-system share of service spend grows

nodes.definition: Impose discipline on changing recurring rates, the single action that touches every account at once. Distinguish the two species of increase: cost-pass-through (the station or platform raised wholesale fees, and the increase is traceable to that) and margin actions (the dealer wants more), and be honest with yourself and the customer about which is happening. Every action requires contractual authority - the rate clause the customer actually signed - and advance notice in plain language with the reason stated. Segment before acting: at-risk accounts on the churn radar, fixed-income and long-tenured customers may be exempted or grandfathered, because the churn triggered by an indiscriminate increase can cost more book value than the increase collects. Measure the churn response of every action as its own experiment before repeating it. Never use opaque drip fees - unexplained line items are the industry's signature trust-destroyer and the cheapest gift to a competitor's takeover pitch.

excluded: initial price setting at account creation (dealer-program KB)
asserting what any rate should be

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: measured churn elasticity from the operator's own past rate actions

pros.claim: Segmented, explained increases collect most of the money with a fraction of the churn
pros.example: passing a station fee rise through with a letter naming the cause, while grandfathering radar-flagged accounts, keeps the reason and the relationship intact

cons.claim: Grandfathering builds a shadow book of below-market accounts
cons.example: years of exemptions accumulate a tenured cohort priced under cost whose eventual correction is even harder

failure_modes: an across-the-book increase with no radar check, converting quiet accounts into cancellations
raising rates without the contract clause that permits it
unexplained line items appearing on statements
acceptance_tests: every rate action has a documented cause class, the enabling contract clause, the exempted segments, the notice artifact, and a measured churn outcome
revisit_triggers: a wholesale or platform cost change lands
churn response of the last action exceeded its predicted band

nodes.definition: Run the first ninety days after the installed system passes from the install crew to monitoring service as a deliberate activation ritual, because early-life churn concentrates exactly where onboarding failed. The ritual: verify the station holds correct premises data and a current emergency-contact tree the customer has actually confirmed; put the customer through a live test signal so they have felt the system work end-to-end; enroll the app and configure one automation that produces daily value (a lock reminder, an arming schedule) so the app opens for reasons other than alarms; teach arm/disarm habits and false-alarm basics including the abort window and their monitoring passcode; and schedule a courtesy check-in inside the first quarter that surfaces small irritations before they compound. The hand-off from installation is a boundary artifact: this node begins where the install KB's commissioning tests end, and it owns the customer's transition from buyer to habituated user.

included: live test signal with the customer
app enrollment with one daily-value automation
excluded: install workmanship and commissioning tests (installation KB)
the selling that created the account (dealer-program KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: cohort data comparing early-life churn of onboarded vs skipped accounts

pros.claim: Habituated users in the first quarter become long-tenured accounts
pros.example: a customer whose app reminds them nightly and who has felt a test alarm resolved correctly rarely entertains a door-knock takeover pitch

cons.claim: The ritual costs scarce post-sale attention on accounts already booked
cons.example: in a heavy install month the check-in calls are the first thing skipped, precisely when the fragile-cohort volume is largest

failure_modes: contact tree never confirmed, so the first real alarm dispatches on a stale phone list
app installed but unconfigured, so engagement flatlines and value goes invisible
no false-alarm coaching, so the first accidental trip becomes a fine and a grudge
acceptance_tests: every new account shows a confirmed contact tree, a completed live test signal, an enrolled app with at least one automation, and a scheduled check-in inside the first quarter
revisit_triggers: early-life churn or first-quarter complaint rates rise
the app platform changes enrollment or automation capability

nodes.definition: Manage false alarms as a continuing service duty for the life of the account, distinct from the install KB's ordinance filings at system birth. The operating loop: review false-dispatch incidents on a regular cadence; triage each to a root cause - user error (retrain, adjust habits), device fault (service ticket), or design fault (route back to the installing organization for correction); tune verification protocols where the station offers them (enhanced call verification, video or audio verification tiers) for accounts with repeat incidents; and coach customers through the local consequence machinery - municipal false-alarm fine schedules, permit standings and repeat-offender escalations are a local-ordinance obligation class that varies by city and must be verified locally, never asserted. A chronically false-alarming account gets an honest remediation-or-exit conversation, because dispatch fatigue endangers real response, fines poison the relationship, and a jurisdiction's response-revocation regimes can strand the customer with an alarm nobody answers.

included: false-dispatch review cadence and root-cause triage
customer coaching on the local ordinance class (verify locally)
excluded: install-time permit registration and ordinance filings (installation KB)
asserting any city's fine schedule

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: false-dispatch rate trends and root-cause mix from the operator's own incident log

pros.claim: Root-cause triage turns a fine-generating account into a loyal one
pros.example: discovering a pet-motion design fault, fixing the sensor placement via the install org, and calling the customer with the explanation converts anger into confidence

cons.claim: Stewardship consumes service capacity on incidents that produce no revenue
cons.example: a busy month of false-dispatch reviews and retraining calls competes directly with billable work

failure_modes: false alarms treated as the customer's problem until the city revokes response
no triage, so user-error accounts get hardware swaps and device-fault accounts get lectures
asserting fine amounts from memory instead of pointing to the current local schedule
acceptance_tests: repeat false-dispatch accounts carry a root-cause code, an intervention record, and a verification-protocol decision; customer-facing ordinance guidance carries the verify-locally flag
revisit_triggers: a served municipality changes its ordinance or moves to verified response
false-dispatch rates rise book-wide after a product or protocol change

nodes.definition: Build and maintain the churn taxonomy that makes retention manageable: moves and home sales; price/value doubt; competitive takeover offers (including door-knock sweep seasons); service failure; non-payment; life events (death, moves to assisted living, divorce); and forced-technology fatigue from sunsets and platform changes. Classify each driver as controllable (service failure, value doubt), partially controllable (moves via the mover program, takeovers via engagement), or uncontrollable (death), so effort lands where it can work. The measurement discipline: every cancellation is coded to a driver with evidence (exit conversation note, ticket history, competitor named), not guessed at quarter-end; codes roll up into gross/net, unit/RMR-weighted and cohort views defined in the economics frame; and the map is a living artifact - the mix shifts with seasons, competitor campaigns and the book's own age structure, and stale maps aim retention spending at last year's problem.

included: roll-up into the frame's attrition measures
excluded: the interventions themselves (save, mover, service nodes)
lead-loss before account creation (dealer-program KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: the operator's own coded cancellation history diverging from the taxonomy's assumed mix

pros.claim: A coded taxonomy converts churn from weather into a work queue
pros.example: seeing service-failure codes spike in one quarter points the fix at the service operation, not at another discount campaign

cons.claim: Coding discipline decays into a junk-drawer 'other' category
cons.example: when exit conversations are skipped, half the quarter's cancels land in 'other' and the map quietly stops steering anything

failure_modes: cancellations coded by whoever processes the paperwork, from imagination
treating moves as pure fate and never building the mover play
one aggregate churn number hiding a fragile early-life cohort
acceptance_tests: every cancellation in the trailing period carries a driver code with an evidence artifact, and the mix report separates controllable from uncontrollable drivers by cohort
revisit_triggers: the driver mix shifts materially between periods
a new driver class appears (a new competitor model, a platform event)

nodes.definition: Detect at-risk accounts before the cancellation call by running a leading-indicator watchlist over the whole book: payment failures and card expiries; app engagement decay on interactive accounts; unresolved or repeat service tickets; failed test signals and silent panels; home-listing signals in served zips (a listed home is a mover in motion); contract-anniversary and end-of-term approach; and competitor sweep seasons in specific neighborhoods, which historically cluster takeover losses in weeks. Each signal has an assigned owner and a routing rule into a playbook (save, mover, service escalation), because an unowned signal is trivia. Two disciplines guard the radar: false-positive restraint - outreach must read as service, not surveillance, so signal thresholds are tuned to avoid pestering healthy accounts - and honesty about what the radar is for: it exists to fix problems and fit service to need, never to preemptively pressure customers into terms they would not otherwise accept.

excluded: the save and mover conversations themselves (their nodes)
any data source the customer relationship does not legitimately expose

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: precision/recall of radar signals measured against actual subsequent cancellations

pros.claim: Signals caught early are cheap saves; cancellations caught late are expensive ones
pros.example: a failed-payment retry plus a service call the same week resolves what would have become a churn statistic and a collection case

cons.claim: An over-tuned radar generates outreach that feels like being watched
cons.example: calling a customer because their app logins dropped reads as creepy unless wrapped in a genuine service reason

failure_modes: signals collected but unowned, scrolling past unactioned
thresholds so loose the save team drowns in false positives
using radar data to front-run customers with pressure instead of service
acceptance_tests: each watchlist signal has a documented threshold, an owner, and a routing rule, and the weekly at-risk list is worked with outcomes recorded
revisit_triggers: save outcomes show a signal class is noise or a real precursor is missing
a new signal source (listing feeds, platform analytics) becomes available

nodes.definition: Run the save - the conversation with a cancelling or at-risk customer - as a diagnostic service interaction with hard ethical rails. Order of operations: diagnose the real reason first, listening before offering, because a discount aimed at a service failure fixes nothing and reads as a bribe; fix service causes before price is ever touched; right-size downward when the tier oversells the need - a downgrade that keeps an honest account beats a lost one and often beats a discounted full tier; use rate adjustments only as documented, plainly-explained offers under the rate-integrity rules; cap attempts so a decided customer is not besieged; and when the answer stays no, exit gracefully - process the lawful cancellation without obstacle courses, phantom retention departments, or surprise-fee ambushes, because an easy exit preserves the referral, the review and the win-back. The playbook's economics are frame-governed: a save's cost is judged against the account's remaining lifetime value, and account-health data ranks who gets proactive save attention first.

excluded: winning brand-new accounts (dealer-program KB)
any retention tactic that obstructs lawful cancellation

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: save-rate, re-cancel and downstream-referral outcomes from the operator's own save log

pros.claim: Diagnose-first saves fix the thing that was actually broken
pros.example: a customer calling to cancel over a mis-billed month stays for years once the billing error is found and refunded, no discount involved

cons.claim: Even ethical saves teach some customers that threatening to cancel gets deals
cons.example: a segment learns to call every renewal season for the adjustment, converting the save desk into a negotiated-rate desk

failure_modes: leading with the discount before hearing the reason
save scripts that shade into fear-selling the neighborhood's crime
cancellation friction that wins the month and loses the reputation
acceptance_tests: every save interaction records the diagnosed reason, the remedy class offered (service fix, downgrade, rate adjustment), the outcome, and completed cancellations show processing without added friction
revisit_triggers: saved accounts re-cancel within months, indicating symptom-patching
save-rate or save-cost drifts outside the frame's lifetime-value logic

nodes.definition: Treat relocation - the largest attrition driver that looks uncontrollable - as a two-account opportunity with a clean legal spine. Play one: keep the moving customer, by catching the move early (radar listing signals, the customer's own notice), offering a transfer path to the new home under a fresh or amended agreement, and coordinating timing so the family is never unmonitored across the move if they want coverage. Play two: win the incoming occupant on the equipment left behind - a takeover of the installed system under a brand-new agreement with fresh disclosure, fresh consent, new user codes and a purged contact tree, never a silent continuation of billing or access under the departed owner's contract. Equipment ownership at move-out must already be clear from contract terms. The program touches real-estate moments (agents, closings) as relationship channels, while the selling mechanics of those channels belong to the acquisition KB; this node owns the account-continuity machinery on the monitoring side.

included: early move detection and transfer path
new-occupant takeover with fresh agreement, consent, codes and contact tree
excluded: realtor-channel lead generation as a sales program (dealer-program KB)
billing the new occupant under the old contract - prohibited

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: mover-retention and takeover-conversion outcomes from the operator's own move cases

pros.claim: The two-account play converts the book's biggest loss column into a growth channel
pros.example: one home sale handled well yields a transferred customer in the new house and a fresh account in the old one, where a mishandled sale yields zero

cons.claim: Move timelines are chaotic and the program's coordination cost is real
cons.example: closings slip, movers vanish mid-process, and a transfer opened too early can strand equipment decisions no one can finalize

failure_modes: learning about the move from the cancellation call
letting the new occupant inherit monitoring on the old owner's codes and contract
ambiguous equipment ownership fought out at the worst possible moment
acceptance_tests: every mover case shows a transfer offer record, and every takeover shows a new agreement, new codes, a rebuilt contact tree and fresh disclosure before monitoring resumed
revisit_triggers: mover-retention or takeover-conversion rates fall
a dispute over equipment ownership or inherited access occurs

nodes.definition: Design the monitoring agreement as the book's legal skeleton, clause by clause. Initial term: length chosen against the account's funding reality without exceeding what the market and jurisdiction tolerate. Renewal structure: month-to-month rollover versus fixed re-terms - evergreen/auto-renewal clauses are a consumer-protection-sensitive class on which many jurisdictions impose disclosure, reminder-notice and consent duties that change; verify current rules in every jurisdiction served before templating. Cancellation: notice windows and methods stated plainly, with no method deliberately burdensome. Rate-change clause: the authority every future rate action will rest on. Liability architecture: limitation-of-liability and subrogation-waiver clauses are industry-standard for alarm services but must be understood and explainable by the operator, not cargo-culted from a forms vendor. Assignability: the clause that makes the book financeable and sellable - absent it, every account transfer needs individual consent and the book's diligence value craters. Execution: e-sign records and template version control, because a book written on six unknown template generations is a diligence nightmare. Counsel review is flagged, not replaced, by this node.

included: term, renewal, cancellation, rate-change, liability and assignability clause architecture
evergreen consumer-protection flag with local verification
template version control and e-sign records
excluded: giving legal advice or asserting any jurisdiction's contract statute
the sales conversation where terms are presented (disclosure node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a consumer-protection rule change, a dispute outcome, or diligence feedback naming a clause deficiency

pros.claim: A clean, assignable, version-controlled agreement multiplies exit options
pros.example: a lender's diligence that finds one current template with assignability across the book prices the RMR seriously; six mystery templates invite a haircut

cons.claim: Maximally protective terms and maximally trustworthy terms are not the same document
cons.example: the longest evergreen with the tightest cancellation window looks strong until a state attorney general's office or a reputation cycle prices its true cost

failure_modes: evergreen mechanics that violate a served jurisdiction's notice duties
no assignability clause discovered at the worst time - during a sale
templates edited ad hoc per deal with no version record
acceptance_tests: the current template covers term, renewal, cancellation, rate-change, liability and assignability; each jurisdiction served has a verified-locally review on record; every signed agreement is retrievable with its template version
revisit_triggers: an auto-renewal or consumer-contract rule changes in a served jurisdiction
renewal friction or dispute data implicates a clause

nodes.definition: Execute every agreement, renewal, save and upgrade disclosure-first. Before signature the customer hears and receives in plain language: the total recurring cost, the initial term's length, exactly what renewal does and when, how to cancel and by when, and what the purchased monitoring does and does not do - a notification-only tier's lack of dispatch is said out loud, not buried in a schedule. Vulnerable-customer care is a first-class rule, not courtesy: with elderly customers and others who may be susceptible to pressure, the pace slows, a family member's involvement is invited, urgency tactics are banned, and the operator would rather lose a sale than sign a customer who does not understand the term. Consent artifacts are stored per account: the signed plain-language summary, e-sign trails, and call recordings where recording is used - noting that consent-to-record is itself a jurisdiction-specific rule class to verify locally. This node is the ethical engine the brief demands at first-class strength: it constrains the save playbook, the renewal practice and the sunset campaigns, and its records are what make the book's consent history diligence-proof.

included: stored consent artifacts with recording-consent flag
constraint authority over saves, renewals and campaigns
excluded: clause drafting itself (contract node)
in-home selling technique (dealer-program KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: complaint patterns, regulator guidance, or audit findings on consent records

pros.claim: Disclosure-first accounts stay because they chose, and their files defend themselves
pros.example: a complaint or regulator inquiry that meets a signed plain-language summary and a clean call recording typically ends there

cons.claim: Full disclosure lengthens the close and loses some marginal signings
cons.example: a customer hearing the term stated plainly may walk where a mumbled schedule would have signed them - which is the rule working, at a real short-term cost

failure_modes: the term and renewal explained only by the document's fine print
an elderly customer signed under time pressure with family kept out of the room
recordings made without checking the jurisdiction's consent-to-record class
acceptance_tests: a sampled new account shows the signed plain-language summary, evidence the customer could restate term and cancel path, and stored consent artifacts; vulnerable-customer interactions show the added care steps
revisit_triggers: a disclosure-related complaint, chargeback or regulator contact
a jurisdiction changes disclosure, cooling-off or recording-consent duties

nodes.definition: Operate renewals as scheduled value conversations rather than silent contractual events. The machinery: a renewal calendar that surfaces every account's term end and renewal date far enough ahead to act; proactive advance notice before any auto-renewal takes effect - sent even where no statute forces it, because the dealer that reminds customers they are about to renew is the dealer whose renewals survive scrutiny and whose book survives diligence; and a renewal conversation that re-earns the account: a system health check, a tier right-size review (down as willingly as up), and any rate change presented with its reason under the rate-integrity rules. The stance: win the renewal on demonstrated service, not on the customer forgetting the window. Renewal friction data - who called confused, who felt trapped, who churned at term - feeds back into contract-terms design, because recurring confusion is a clause defect, not a customer defect.

included: renewal as health-check and right-size conversation
excluded: the legal drafting of renewal clauses (contract node)
acquiring replacement accounts (dealer-program KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: term-end churn, renewal-complaint and notice-timing data from the operator's own cycles

pros.claim: Proactive renewal notice converts a legal risk surface into a loyalty event
pros.example: a reminder letter with a free system check offer reads as care; the same renewal discovered on a statement reads as a trap

cons.claim: Reminding everyone invites some cancellations silence would have kept
cons.example: a slice of auto-renewals that would have rolled quietly instead uses the reminder to leave - revenue the honest practice knowingly forgoes

failure_modes: renewals discovered by customers on statements, generating trap complaints
the calendar exists but notices go out after the cancellation window closed
renewal calls used to upsell instead of right-size
acceptance_tests: every renewal in the trailing period shows an advance notice sent before the effective date and before the cancellation window closed, and renewal conversations record the health-check and right-size outcome
revisit_triggers: renewal-window complaints or term-end churn spikes
a jurisdiction changes auto-renewal notice duties

nodes.definition: Handle non-payment with a ladder that never confuses a billing problem with a bad customer and never silently strands a home that relies on life-safety monitoring. The ladder: automatic retry and card-updater mechanics for the large share of failures that are expired or reissued cards; soft reminders; a human contact that distinguishes can't-pay (hardship - offer a pause, a downgrade, a payment plan) from won't-pay (a dispute in disguise - route to its real cause) from billing-error (the dealer's own fault - fix and apologize); then formal dated suspension notice; then suspension. The life-safety rule sits above the ladder: an account with active fire or medical monitoring is never disconnected by automation alone - documented human contact and clear dated notice precede any suspension, and rules constraining discontinuation of such services are a jurisdiction-specific class to verify before the policy is set. Write-offs close with dignity and a win-back path, because a household's finances recover and remembers who treated them decently.

included: dunning ladder with retry and card-updater mechanics
life-safety suspension rule with verify-locally flag
excluded: third-party debt-collection law specifics (professional territory - flag, not assert)
credit decisions at account creation (dealer-program KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: recovery rates by ladder stage and any life-safety continuity incident

pros.claim: Card-updater and retry mechanics quietly rescue most failures before a human is needed
pros.example: a reissued card after a bank breach never becomes a churn event because the update happened automatically and a receipt confirmed it

cons.claim: Patience with non-payers accumulates real unpaid wholesale cost
cons.example: every month a non-paying account stays live, the dealer still owes the station and platform their fees for it

failure_modes: automation suspending a fire-monitored home over a failed card with no human contact
dunning tone that converts a fixable hardship into an angry cancellation
billing errors pursued as delinquencies
acceptance_tests: no life-safety account in the trailing period was suspended without a documented human contact and dated notice, and the ladder's stage timings and triage codes are recorded per case
revisit_triggers: a suspension incident on a life-safety account
failure-rate spikes from processor or card-network events

nodes.definition: Operate the bridge between the service desk and the retention outcome, because service failure is the churn driver the dealer most completely controls. The bridge's spans: ticket service levels the customer can feel (response and resolution clocks appropriate to severity); a remote-first resolution discipline measured as a rate, since every phone-fixed ticket is margin saved and a truck roll avoided; repeat-ticket flagging, because the second visit for the same fault is a churn signal wearing a work order; chronic-system identification - systems whose fault history has consumed multiples of a normal account's service budget get routed to a redesign-or-replace decision and an honest conversation, not an endless parts carousel; and post-visit experience measurement, because a technically-closed ticket that left an annoyed customer is not closed. Outputs flow both ways: service data feeds the churn radar and the attrition map, and measured cost reality feeds back into service-plan pricing.

included: felt service levels and severity clocks
data flows to radar, map and plan pricing
excluded: install-defect warranty ownership (installation KB)
the save conversation triggered by a service failure (save node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: correlation between the operator's service metrics and its service-coded churn

pros.claim: Repeat-ticket flags catch churn while it is still a service problem
pros.example: the second no-fix visit auto-escalating to a senior tech with an apology call keeps an account the third identical visit would have lost

cons.claim: Aggressive service levels on every ticket overspend on the indifferent
cons.example: same-day urgency for a cosmetic keypad complaint burns capacity the genuinely-broken systems needed

failure_modes: tickets closed on technicality while the fault persists
chronic systems bleeding plan margin for years because nobody aggregates fault history
service data never reaching the radar, so retention learns of failures from cancellations
acceptance_tests: repeat-ticket and chronic-system flags exist and fire, remote-first rate is measured, and service events appear in the churn radar's inputs
revisit_triggers: service-failure-coded churn rises
remote-first rate or repeat-ticket rate trends worsen

nodes.definition: Maintain a per-account composite score that turns the book from an undifferentiated list into a ranked decision surface. Components, each a mechanism over the operator's own data: margin health (RMR minus stacked wholesale/platform costs minus trailing service cost for this account); engagement (app activity where applicable, test-signal participation); signal-path currency (radio generation, supervision status); payment behavior; and tenure/cohort risk (early-life accounts score fragile by default). Uses: rank the save queue so proactive attention lands on valuable-and-at-risk first; drive rate-action exemptions; surface the fix-or-exit list of negative-margin accounts that deserve an honest repricing or right-sizing conversation; and feed book-level roll-ups that valuation work reads. Limits: the score is a decision aid - it never licenses degrading contracted service to a low-scoring account, and its components stay explainable so a human can always answer why an account ranked where it did.

included: margin, engagement, path, payment and cohort components
excluded: degrading contracted service by score - prohibited
credit scoring of applicants (dealer-program KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: backtests of score-ranked risk against the operator's realized cancellations

pros.claim: Ranked attention beats alphabetical attention
pros.example: the save desk working a health-ranked queue reaches the high-value at-risk account today instead of after it cancelled

cons.claim: Composite scores can hide the one component that matters
cons.example: a healthy-looking blended score can mask a dead signal path if weights are careless - the component views must stay visible

failure_modes: trailing service cost omitted, so chronic accounts look profitable
an unexplainable score nobody trusts or acts on
the fix-or-exit list drifting into quiet service degradation instead of honest conversations
acceptance_tests: each component is computable from named internal data, every account shows a current score with visible components, and the fix-or-exit list's actions are conversations on record, not service changes
revisit_triggers: score-predicted risk diverges from realized churn
a new data source (platform analytics, supervision feeds) becomes available

nodes.definition: Understand what a buyer or lender actually prices when they price a monitored-account book, so every operating choice is made with its valuation consequence visible. The priced drivers: demonstrated attrition history (the dominant driver - a book is a claim on future RMR, and attrition is the discount rate the buyer applies to that claim); average RMR and margin per account after the stacked costs; contract quality - remaining terms, renewal structure and above all assignability, since unassignable paper transfers only with per-customer consent; geographic density, because a scattered book is expensive to service and a dense one is cheap to absorb; signal-path currency, since a sunset overhang is deferred cost the buyer deducts; customer and cohort mix; and documentation completeness, which the audit node operationalizes. Multiples are strictly a market mechanism here: buyers express price as a multiple of RMR, the multiple offered moves with these drivers and with credit conditions, and any real number comes from actual bids on this actual book - folklore multiples from trade-show hallways are not planning inputs. This node prices the drivers; the decision to sell or hold accounts at creation belongs to the dealer-program KB.

included: the priced-driver catalog and how each moves value
operating decisions read through valuation consequence
excluded: quoting any multiple as fact
the sell-vs-hold decision at account creation (dealer-program KB)
brokering or deal advice

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: real bids, lender terms or diligence findings on this book or a comparable one

pros.claim: Driver visibility turns daily operations into valuation compounding
pros.example: seeing that attrition history dominates the eventual multiple reframes a save program from cost center to equity construction

cons.claim: Managing to the buyer's checklist can distort service priorities
cons.example: chasing contract-term optics a buyer likes while neglecting the service quality that actually holds attrition down optimizes the symbol over the substance

failure_modes: planning around a folklore multiple no bid ever confirmed
discovering unassignable contracts during a sale process
ignoring sunset overhang until a buyer's diligence prices it for you
acceptance_tests: the operator can produce a driver-by-driver self-assessment of its own book (attrition history, margin, contract quality, density, path currency, documentation) with each driver sourced from internal records
revisit_triggers: an actual bid, lender term sheet or diligence report prices the drivers differently than assumed
credit conditions or buyer appetite in the account-acquisition market shift

nodes.definition: Keep the book permanently diligence-grade instead of scrambling when a buyer or lender appears. The per-account file: the signed agreement with its template version and assignability clause; the disclosure and consent artifacts (plain-language summary, e-sign trail, recordings where lawfully made); payment history; monitoring history (test signals, supervision status, false-alarm record); and the equipment and communicator record including radio generation. The habit: an annual internal audit that samples accounts and reads them as a buyer's lawyer would - can this account's existence, consent, terms and payment be proven from the file alone? - with gaps traced to their intake-process cause and fixed there, because remediating files one by one without fixing intake refills the hole. The payoff is dual: diligence that closes instead of collapsing, and a compliance posture where any single account can defend itself in a complaint or regulator inquiry years after signature.

excluded: conducting an actual sale process or engaging brokers
legal opinions on file sufficiency (counsel territory - flag)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: audit sample results and any diligence or regulator event testing the files

pros.claim: Always-ready files collapse the time and haircut of any capital event
pros.example: a lender's sample audit finding every requested file complete in days, not months, keeps the pricing conversation about the book instead of about the gaps

cons.claim: Sustained hygiene is unglamorous overhead with a payoff that may be years away
cons.example: the annual audit competes for attention against this quarter's installs every single year until the day it is priceless

failure_modes: consent artifacts missing for a whole cohort signed under an old process
audits that fix sampled files but never the intake defect that starved them
equipment and communicator records living only in a technician's memory
acceptance_tests: a random account sample yields complete files (agreement, consent, payment, monitoring, equipment) and the last annual audit's gap list shows intake-level fixes, not just file patches
revisit_triggers: an audit, complaint or diligence event exposes a file-class gap
a records-retention or documentation rule changes in a served jurisdiction

the bridge's remote-first and chronic-system disciplines operate the cost mechanisms the plan priced

edges.why_related: video monetization operates inside the boundary's privacy, access-logging and retention discipline
edges.risk_of_conflict: storage-revenue incentives pushing retention windows and camera counts past disclosed need

edges.why_related: every save offer must restate cost, term and cancellation effects as honestly as the original sale
edges.risk_of_conflict: save urgency degrading into re-lock offers whose terms the customer never truly heard

edges.why_related: campaign urgency may cite only the dated carrier or manufacturer notice, and swap agreements need fresh disclosure

edges.why_related: unmanaged false alarms generate fines, dispatch fatigue and response revocation that surface as service-failure and value-doubt churn
service quality measured on the bridge is the largest controllable input to the map's service-failure driver
weak onboarding manufactures the early-life disengagement signals the radar later detects
