both are honest value-re-anchoring conversations with an existing customer, sharing the health-check, right-size and plain-terms toolkit

conflict_axes.name: dispatched_protection_vs_price_accessibility
conflict_axes.description: Full central-station monitoring delivers dispatched response and justifies durable RMR but costs more; self/cloud notification-only tiers are affordable and DIY-competitive but dispatch nothing.
poles: professional dispatched monitoring as the default offer
affordable notification-only tiers for price-sensitive homes
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: offer both, place each customer by honest need conversation, and make the absence of dispatch explicit on every notification-only sale

conflict_axes.name: rmr_growth_vs_need_driven_attach
conflict_axes.description: Every added subscription line compounds book value, but attach targets pressure staff to sell video and plans into homes that will not use them, manufacturing churn and distrust.
poles: maximize attach and RMR per account
attach only what the home demonstrably needs
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: need-driven attach is the rule; measure add-on dormancy and churn as the honesty audit of every attach push

conflict_axes.name: contract_lock_vs_customer_trust
conflict_axes.description: Long terms and tight evergreen mechanics stabilize the book on paper, but they corrode trust, generate trap complaints and sit exposed to consumer-protection regimes that keep tightening.
poles: maximize contractual lock and term length
maximize freely-chosen, reminded renewals
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: disclosure-first shorter structures with proactive renewal notice; retention is earned by service, and the contract exists to make expectations explicit, not to imprison

conflict_axes.name: rate_action_vs_churn_exposure
conflict_axes.description: Rising wholesale and platform costs demand rate increases, but each increase is a churn event whose losses can exceed its collections, especially on radar-flagged accounts.
poles: protect margin with timely increases
protect the book by absorbing cost drift
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: pass through documented cost rises with stated reasons and advance notice, segment out at-risk and vulnerable accounts, and measure each action's churn response before repeating it

conflict_axes.name: save_persistence_vs_graceful_exit
conflict_axes.description: Fighting for every cancellation maximizes short-term retention, but sieges of a decided customer destroy referrals, reviews and the win-back path an easy exit preserves.
poles: persist until the account is saved
let decided customers leave easily
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: diagnose-first with capped attempts; when the answer stays no, process the lawful cancellation cleanly and plant the win-back

conflict_axes.name: automation_scale_vs_human_moments
conflict_axes.description: Dunning ladders, radar alerts and renewal notices must be automated to run at book scale, but life events, hardship and life-safety suspensions handled by automation alone produce cruelty and liability.
poles: automate every lifecycle touch
route high-stakes moments to humans
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: automate detection and routine notices; hard-route life-safety suspensions, bereavement, hardship and vulnerable-customer contacts to a human with authority to deviate

conflict_axes.name: buyer_optics_vs_subscriber_experience
conflict_axes.description: Optimizing the book for a buyer's checklist (term length, lock mechanics, headline RMR) can diverge from optimizing the subscriber's experience, though the two mostly align through attrition.
poles: shape the book for diligence optics
shape the book for subscriber outcomes
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: low attrition serves both masters, so invest there; where the two genuinely diverge, subscriber honesty wins and the valuation story is told through demonstrated retention instead

conflict_axes.name: video_monetization_vs_privacy_discipline
conflict_axes.description: Cloud-video revenue rewards more cameras, longer retention windows and richer analytics, while privacy discipline demands minimal retention, logged access and strictly defensive purpose.
poles: grow video RMR aggressively
hold the privacy and purpose line
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the boundary is absolute: video offerings grow only within disclosed retention, logged access and defensive purpose, and any monetization idea that needs to bend those is dead on arrival

conflict_axes.name: sunset_urgency_vs_fear_free_selling
conflict_axes.description: Radio sunsets impose real deadlines that customers must act on, but deadline messaging sits one adjective away from the fear-selling the business has forsworn.
poles: press the deadline hard to force completion
underplay the deadline to stay gentle
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state the verifiable, dated carrier or manufacturer fact plainly and repeatedly through escalating waves; the real deadline needs no embellishment and gentle vagueness strands customers unmonitored

conflict_axes.name: plan_generosity_vs_chronic_drain
conflict_axes.description: Generous service plans retain accounts and simplify every conversation, but the chronic-system tail can quietly consume the whole plan pool's margin.
poles: cover everything to retain everyone
restrict coverage to protect the pool
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: generous scope with remote-first discipline and a chronic-system flag that routes repeat offenders to redesign-or-replace conversations instead of infinite parts

edge_cases.description: A carrier announces a radio sunset that will silence a large slice of the book's communicators at once
edge_cases.trigger: carrier or manufacturer end-of-life announcement covering deployed radio generations
edge_cases.mitigation: pull the affected population from the communicator inventory immediately, plan outreach waves against the announced date, segment subsidize-vs-charge by account health, and verify every swap with a live signal test

edge_cases.description: A monitored customer dies or moves to assisted living and the family calls to cancel mid-term
edge_cases.trigger: bereavement or care-transition cancellation request from a non-signatory family member
edge_cases.mitigation: route to a human immediately, verify authority compassionately, waive save attempts and early-termination theater, close or transfer with dignity and code the driver as a life event

edge_cases.description: The wholesale central station suffers an outage or a visible response-quality slide
edge_cases.trigger: missed or delayed signal handling incidents at the station
edge_cases.mitigation: invoke the station agreement's performance terms, demand incident reports, communicate honestly with affected customers, and re-open the stack decision including portability options if degradation persists

edge_cases.description: A served municipality adopts verified response and police stop responding to unverified alarms
edge_cases.trigger: local ordinance change to a verified-response regime
edge_cases.mitigation: verify the new local rules, add or promote video/audio verification capability for affected accounts, retrain customers on what dispatch now requires, and update tier sheets so promises match the new reality

edge_cases.description: An account with active fire or medical monitoring goes delinquent and the dunning ladder reaches suspension
edge_cases.trigger: sustained non-payment on a life-safety account
edge_cases.mitigation: halt automated suspension, make documented human contact, offer hardship options, issue clear dated notice, and verify jurisdiction rules on discontinuing life-safety services before any cutoff

edge_cases.description: A homeowner asks to switch monitoring of a competitor-installed system to the dealer and the panel turns out to be proprietary-locked
edge_cases.trigger: monitoring takeover request on locked or unsupported competitor equipment
edge_cases.mitigation: assess takeover feasibility honestly before promising anything, disclose replacement needs and costs as mechanisms, and refuse workarounds that would leave signals unsupervised or terms misrepresented

edge_cases.description: One account generates repeated false dispatches and the city is escalating fines toward response revocation
edge_cases.trigger: chronic false-alarm pattern with municipal enforcement escalating
edge_cases.mitigation: run root-cause triage (user, device, design), fix or route the cause, tune verification protocols, coach the customer through the local ordinance process with a verify-locally flag, and hold the remediation-or-exit conversation if the pattern survives

edge_cases.description: A state where part of the book lives changes its auto-renewal disclosure or reminder-notice requirements
edge_cases.trigger: consumer-protection rule change in a served jurisdiction
edge_cases.mitigation: flag for counsel-class review, amend templates and notice flows for that jurisdiction, remediate in-flight renewals, and record the verification so the book's compliance posture stays provable

edge_cases.description: A card-network breach or mass reissue event breaks payment methods across a large share of the book simultaneously
edge_cases.trigger: processor or card-network event spiking payment failures book-wide
edge_cases.mitigation: lean on account-updater and retry mechanics, suppress dunning tone escalation for the event cohort, communicate the cause honestly, and track the cohort separately so radar thresholds do not misfire

edge_cases.description: A home sells and the new occupant wants to keep the installed, still-communicating system
edge_cases.trigger: occupancy change with equipment left behind
edge_cases.mitigation: never continue billing or access under the departed owner's agreement; write a fresh contract with fresh disclosure, new user codes and a rebuilt contact tree before monitoring resumes for the new household

edge_cases.description: The cloud-video platform discontinues a deployed camera line or shuts down its storage integration
edge_cases.trigger: platform end-of-life or API termination affecting subscribed video accounts
edge_cases.mitigation: treat it as a sunset-class campaign: enumerate affected subscriptions, stop billing for storage that no longer functions, present replacement options with costs as mechanisms, and keep the platform-diversity lesson for the next stack decision

edge_cases.description: A customer asks the dealer to use monitored cameras to watch a neighbor, an ex-partner or a domestic worker covertly
edge_cases.trigger: surveillance-misuse request on a monitored video account
edge_cases.mitigation: refuse the configuration, restate the defensive-purpose policy, document the refusal, and if the request implies unlawful surveillance, decline the related service entirely

priority_rationale: The economics frame and the lawful-defensive boundary come first because every downstream choice is judged in their terms; the monitoring stack and signal-path work follow because tiers, onboarding and campaigns all ride the chosen infrastructure; the tier ladder, video line, service plan and contract architecture then define what is sold and on what paper; disclosure, onboarding and the retention apparatus (driver map, radar, saves, movers, renewals, rate and collections discipline) operate the book day to day; and the health score, valuation drivers and audit readiness come last because they measure and preserve what everything upstream built.

dominance_rules.rule: The lawful-defensive and privacy boundary dominates every monetization choice
dominance_rules.rationale: one covert-surveillance accommodation or privacy breach can end the business and harm people in ways no RMR repays
dominance_rules.trigger: any video, monitoring or retention idea that touches purpose, privacy, access or retention windows
dominance_rules.action: test the idea against the boundary first; if it needs the boundary bent, it dies regardless of revenue

dominance_rules.rule: Disclosure-first dominates every save, renewal, rate and upgrade urgency
dominance_rules.rationale: an account kept through obscured terms is a liability wearing an RMR label, and consent records are the book's legal spine
dominance_rules.trigger: any customer conversation involving terms, cost, renewal or a deadline
dominance_rules.action: restate cost, term and cancel path plainly before closing; no urgency justifies skipping it

dominance_rules.rationale: silently disconnecting a fire- or medical-monitored home converts a billing problem into a potential tragedy and legal exposure
dominance_rules.trigger: a delinquent account with active life-safety monitoring reaching suspension stage
dominance_rules.action: halt automation, make documented human contact, issue dated notice, verify jurisdiction rules before any cutoff

dominance_rules.rule: Verified dated fact dominates urgency framing in every campaign
dominance_rules.rationale: the no-fear-selling identity survives only if deadline language is always attributable to a carrier, manufacturer or ordinance document
dominance_rules.trigger: drafting any sunset, upgrade or renewal urgency communication
dominance_rules.action: cite the dated source notice; strike any claim that cannot be attributed to it

dominance_rules.rule: Service-fix dominates discount in save attempts
dominance_rules.rationale: discounts aimed at service failures buy silence, not retention, and teach customers to negotiate instead of report problems
dominance_rules.trigger: a save conversation where the diagnosed cause is service-related
dominance_rules.action: fix and verify the service cause first; price moves only if the diagnosis is genuinely price

dominance_rules.rule: Jurisdiction verification dominates template and policy reuse
dominance_rules.rationale: licensing, evergreen, recording-consent and discontinuation rules vary by state and city and change; a portable assumption is a latent violation
dominance_rules.trigger: entering a territory, templating a contract, recording calls, or setting suspension policy
dominance_rules.action: run the verify-locally check for that jurisdiction and record it before the practice ships

dominance_rules.rule: The customer's demonstrated need dominates attach and tier targets
dominance_rules.rationale: dormant add-ons churn, poison trust and convert the honest-dealer identity into a quota machine
dominance_rules.trigger: any attach, upsell or tier-placement decision
dominance_rules.action: place the customer on the rung the home needs; record the need basis for the attach

dominance_rules.rule: Easy lawful cancellation dominates every book-stability tactic
dominance_rules.rationale: friction retention destroys referrals, reviews, win-backs and regulatory standing - the assets a small dealer actually lives on
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer states a decision to cancel after capped save attempts
dominance_rules.action: process the cancellation cleanly by the contract's stated method and close with the win-back door open

dominance_rules.rule: Documented consent dominates billing and access convenience
dominance_rules.rationale: billing a new occupant on an old contract or reusing inherited codes is unauthorized charging and unauthorized access, not efficiency
dominance_rules.trigger: occupancy changes, takeovers, transfers or any billing continuation across parties
dominance_rules.action: new party, new agreement, new disclosure, new codes, rebuilt contact tree - before service resumes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Define the attrition taxonomy and coding discipline before launching any retention program
anti_rework_rules.prevents: retention spending aimed by guesswork that must be re-aimed once real driver data finally exists

anti_rework_rules.rule: Vet the central station's certification, redundancy and account-portability terms before migrating any accounts onto it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a hostage book that must be painfully re-migrated or re-papered when station quality or terms fail

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the plain-language disclosure summary and consent-storage process before the first agreement is signed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a cohort of accounts with unprovable consent that no later remediation can fully repair

anti_rework_rules.rule: Inventory communicator radio generations before planning any upgrade or sunset campaign
anti_rework_rules.prevents: campaign waves built on guesses that miss affected accounts and re-visit unaffected ones

anti_rework_rules.rule: Measure truck-roll cost and remote-fix rate before publishing service-plan pricing
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an underpriced plan whose correction requires a book-wide repricing event and its churn

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify each jurisdiction's auto-renewal and cancellation rule classes before templating the agreement for it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: template rewrites and in-flight renewal remediation across an entire territory's cohort

anti_rework_rules.rule: Build the per-account diligence file at account birth, not at sale time
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a pre-diligence archaeology project across years of accounts that stalls or reprices the deal

anti_rework_rules.rule: Score account health and flag at-risk segments before executing any rate action
anti_rework_rules.prevents: churn waves from indiscriminate increases that cost more book value than they collect

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm assignability language exists in the template before assuming the book is financeable or sellable
anti_rework_rules.prevents: per-customer consent chases and valuation haircuts discovered mid-transaction

iteration_protocol.trigger: monthly net or gross attrition moves outside its trailing band
iteration_protocol.action: re-code the period's cancellations with evidence, update the driver mix, and re-aim radar thresholds and save priorities

iteration_protocol.trigger: a carrier radio sunset, panel end-of-life or camera-platform termination is announced
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the communicator and platform inventory, enumerate the affected population, and launch the campaign per the wave protocol

iteration_protocol.trigger: a consumer-protection, licensing or recording-consent rule changes in a served jurisdiction
iteration_protocol.action: flag counsel-class review, amend templates and notice flows, remediate in-flight cases, and record the verification

iteration_protocol.trigger: saved accounts re-cancel within months or the save rate declines
iteration_protocol.action: audit save cases for symptom-patching, re-weight service-fix-first, and check whether service operations are exporting the problem

iteration_protocol.trigger: a rate action's churn response exceeds its predicted band
iteration_protocol.action: pause the remaining waves, re-segment with health scores, widen grandfathering, and re-estimate elasticity before resuming

iteration_protocol.trigger: station response performance degrades or wholesale terms worsen materially
iteration_protocol.action: invoke agreement performance terms, evaluate alternative stations using the portability clause, and re-run the stack decision

iteration_protocol.trigger: an internal audit, complaint or diligence event exposes a documentation or consent gap class
iteration_protocol.action: remediate the affected files, trace the gap to its intake cause, and fix the intake process so the class cannot recur

iteration_protocol.trigger: video-tier dormancy, churn or attach quality deteriorates
iteration_protocol.action: audit attach honesty and camera health, re-verify value communication, and right-size subscriptions that never earned their fee
